product: Late Smart Tool document completion saves its artifact without replacing a newer client selection. Saved-only completion retains Settings and reports that the current view is unchanged.

reproduction.scenario: Hold Alpha document after actual SDK read; explicitly open Bravo and fill local input; release Alpha. Original implementation replaced Bravo and unmounted its input.
reproduction.originalWrapperPrerequisite: Initial attempt used incorrect Counter Read capitalization; retained separately and not counted as product evidence.

checks: Newer explicit tool view and its unsaved input survive late older document completion.
An already executed old resource read cannot replace the current iframe, result, selection or input.
Close/reopen ABA keeps the same current artifact and local input.
Saved-only operation is truthfully labeled and does not dismiss the newer Settings visit.
Four explicit opens, no runtime/model requests, saved chat and private composer draft unchanged.

ownership.scope: Attached browser clients use the existing canonical selectionRevision; latest pending opens are per client and removed in finally.
ownership.unboundAgent: Retains legacy global presentation and session-scoped saving. Separate background sessions do not supersede one another; this is not an unbound legacy-API ABA guarantee.

limits: Deterministic local MCP SDK subprocesses and synthetic conversation runtime; no external account, live provider or cross-platform qualification.
Desktop pointer scenario; no new touch/keyboard or controlled performance claim.
